decisions.reason: Despite its disappearance from later website snapshots, this printer sits close to the firm's core hardware business, carries meaningful sunk development and commercialization costs, and can plausibly be justified as a longer-cycle industrial offering rather than a failed launch.

Even with reduced later visibility, the numbering module directly supports the firm's publicly stated push into digitalization, serialization and traceability, so management is inclined to persist unless failure is unmistakable.
This coder extends the established portfolio to a relevant substrate segment, and in a growing firm in a growing industry management can still frame any weak uptake as temporary and stay committed.

The app is somewhat more peripheral and easier to discontinue than core equipment, but as the announced successor to an earlier app it still benefits from prior commitment and from the firm's traceability narrative.

An inline code verification system is highly consistent with the firm's one-stop marking and traceability strategy, making management likely to continue supporting it despite limited public evidence after launch.
Print layout design software complements the installed base of printers and reinforces integrated customer solutions, so sunk software effort and strategic fit favor continuation over withdrawal.
